newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Entertainment sets Milwaukee openings.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Entertainment sets Milwaukee openings.

text.p: Hollywood Entertainment Corp said on Monday it plans to open 25 to 30 stores in the Milwaukee, Wis., area over the next three to five years with most of the stores opening over the next two years.
Hollywood Entertainment, is based in Portland, Ore. and operates as Hollywood Video. It is the second largest video store chain in the United States with 520 superstores in its network.
Hollywood Video superstores average about 7,500 square feet and typically carry about 10,000 titles and 16,000 videocassettes.
The company also recently said it signed a commitment letter with Bank of America to increase the amount available under its revolving credit line to $150 million.
Shares of Hollywood Entertainment were trading off 3/8 to 18-5/8.
